project_name: Serpulo Command - Mindustry Campaign Tracker UI
archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / TACTICAL INDUSTRIAL COMMAND

heading_rules.letter_spacing: tracking-wider or tracking-tight depending on overline vs title

visual_enhancers.border_style: Hairline 1px metallic borders (#343845) with sharp or slightly rounded corners (rounded-sm/rounded-none)
visual_enhancers.panel_texture: Subtle industrial grid lines background overlay (24px grid at 3% opacity)
visual_enhancers.indicators: Status dots with subtle pulse keyframe animation for 'Under Attack' sectors
visual_enhancers.corner_brackets: Industrial corner ticks or left border status accent strips (3px solid green/orange/red)
visual_enhancers.chip_styling: Matte dark background (#15161a) with 1px border (#2a2d37) and pixel-art 32x32 Mindustry item sprites

layout.header: Fixed top bar with backdrop-blur-md bg-[#121317]/90 border-b border-[#343845] z-50 px-4 md:px-8
layout.grid_sectors: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-5 gap-3.5 (Compact 5 per row layout on xl)
layout.container: Full-width dashboard container with px-4 py-6 max-w-[1800px] mx-auto
layout.planet_view: Split layout: 3D/SVG dark planet viewport with tactical overlay side panel showing sector info and threat distribution

component_design.buttons: Industrial style with rounded-sm, font-mono, tracking-wider, uppercase text, primary in #ffd37f amber with bold dark text
component_design.cards: Dark panel surface #1a1b20, hairline #343845 border, hover:border-[#ffd37f]/50 hover:shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(255,211,127,0.1)] transition-all
component_design.badges: Compact monospace pill badges with status-tinted borders and background (e.g. Captured: bg-[#38d39f]/10 text-[#38d39f] border-[#38d39f]/30)
component_design.inputs_and_selects: Dark background #121317, border #343845, focus:border-[#ffd37f] text-slate-200. ABSOLUTELY NO TRANSPARENT BACKGROUNDS on dropdown menus or select items.
component_design.tables: Dark metallic header #17181f with border-b #343845, alternating row hover effect with bg-[#22242c]
component_design.charts: Recharts with dark surface #1a1b20, axis color #94a3b8, grid color #282a36, tooltip dark background #121317 with #ffd37f border

instructions_to_main_agent: Import Google Fonts 'JetBrains Mono' and 'IBM Plex Sans' in public/index.html or src/index.css.
Update src/index.css with the dark mode CSS variables and Mindustry dark base styles.
Ensure all dropdowns, select menus, dialogs, and popovers have solid non-transparent background (#121317 or #1a1b20).
Apply data-testid attributes to all interactive elements, cards, inputs, and buttons.
Replace light theme colors and indigo accents with Mindustry amber (#ffd37f), dark steel panels (#1a1b20), and tactical status badges.
Test all components and ensure responsive 5-column grid layout for sector cards on xl screens.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_slop: Avoid generic centered white/light layouts or soft rounded blue SaaS themes. Use dark industrial tactical UI with Mindustry amber accent.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.transitions: Do not apply transition: all globally. Apply targeted CSS transitions for background-color, border-color, and opacity.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes.
